interpretation: The saved IFN-gamma, TNF and IL-2 source coefficients agree with the same assigned nonlinear activity rule. This verifies implementation of the common source law, not three independently measured cytokine responses.

The latent half-life does not equal the source half-time. A state-dependent analytic decay is a conditional continuation, not a measured or realized future trajectory; subsequent activity, division, transitions and death can change it.

The hourly files cannot establish minute-scale withdrawal dynamics. The no-input calculation only evaluates the existing law. Positive floating-point tails must not be counted as biologically active cells.

The zero-memory branch is a structurally distinct recent-delivery gate. It can expose a cumulative-history-weighted amplitude, and becomes zero at the next phenotype update without new delivery. It is not the zero-positive-half-life limit.

The primary source distinguishes calcium, phosphorylation and mRNA observables. Numerical proximity of an mRNA half-time to 15 minutes cannot validate a damage-history state or extracellular secretion kinetics.
The completed memory sentinels establish sensitivity of this conditional model. They do not identify the central half-life, activity threshold, source cap, or common CD4/CD8 and cytokine laws.
specific_remaining_basis: Provide a quantitative bridge from an applicable measured observable to the latent damage-history/source law, or an independently justified phenomenological hypothesis with a declared claim-specific sensitivity range. The existing 0/15/150 settings are not a calibrated interval.

followup_decision.reason: No new implementation error was found. The remaining gap is the biological observable mapping and quantitative choice basis, which repeating current settings cannot resolve.
